text:
anya (partnerships): Quick sync — need to confirm market-by-market entitlements & tax handling for our cloud listings (AWS/GCP/Azure) in APAC/EU.
mason (eng): Do we have per-region AMI/container artifacts or a single global image? affects egress and compliance.
jen (legal): For EU: VAT reverse-charge vs local VAT depends on where we have nexus. Need sales tax team input. Also: EULA localization required for DE/FR/ES at launch.
oliver (product): Packaging decision: single SKU with region entitlements or separate SKUs per region? separate SKUs gives pricing flexibility but complicates trials.
kyle (aws-partner): From AWS side we'll need publisher roles + marketplace-entitlement mapping. SAML for buyer provisioning is supported. Share exact ARNs/roles.
anya (partnerships): @kyle can you confirm default publisher role naming? also do we get marketplace metering IDs ahead of publish?
kyle (aws-partner): We'll provision a sandbox metering ID. role name: arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/RedwoodMarketplacePublisher-prod
mason (eng): If we go single artifact, we should include region-specific manifests. Example manifest snippet:
```
{ "regions": ["us-east-1","eu-west-1","ap-northeast-1"], "artifact": "redwood-inference-v1.tar.gz" }
```
oliver (product): Trial flow: enable 14-day trial entitlement flagged on the marketplace; need backend flagging and grace period logic in our subscriptions service.
jen (legal): Also flagging: trial terms need to be appended to TOS for marketplace buyers. I'll draft an addendum and localize.
marketplace-bot: onboarding docs: https://internal.redwood/marketplace/onboarding — checklist, sample manifests, legal template
anya (partnerships): Action items: 1) jen draft addendum by Wed 2) mason add region manifests + sample CI job 3) kyle confirm metering ID by EOD 4) oliver decide SKU approach by Thurs
mason (eng): Will add a CI job that uploads manifests to staging. PR to follow.
oliver (product): leaning single SKU with region entitlements. will write pros/cons doc and share.
jen (legal): I'll start translations for DE/FR and sync with localization vendor.
anya (partnerships): Great — tagging owners in the board. If anything blocks, ping here. :raised_hands:
